local UIWindow = require("FairyGUI.UIWindow")
local UIWindowBase = require("FairyGUI.UIWindowBase")

---@class UIModal: UIWindow
local UIModal = class("UIModal", UIWindow)
UIModal.ModalContentUrl = false

function UIModal:ctor(cmpCls, asyncMode, ...)
    assert(UIModal.ModalContentUrl, "Please set UIModal.ModalContentUrl first!")

    ---@type IComponent
    self.m_cmpCls = cmpCls
    ---@type any[]
    self.m_ctorArgs = {...}

    ---@type boolean
    self.m_closeWhenClickFrame = false
    ---@type FairyGUI.GComponent
    self.m_modalFrame = false
    ---@type FairyGUI.GLoader
    self.m_loader = false
    ---@type FairyGUI.GComponent
    self.m_content = false
    ---@type FairyGUI.GComponent
    self.m_loaderFrame = false
    self.modal = true
    
    local packages = self:GetAllPackages()
    UIWindowBase.ctor(self, UIModal.ModalContentUrl, packages, asyncMode)
end

---@return FairyGUI.GComponent
function UIModal:GetContent()
    return self.m_content
end

---OnInit 创建组件之后，界面打开之间会调用该方法，可在该方法中进行初始化操作
---@protected
function UIModal:OnInit()
    local content = self.contentPane
    ---@type FairyGUI.GLoader
    local loader = content:GetChild("content")
    loader.url = self.m_cmpCls.URL
    self.m_loader = loader
    self.m_loaderFrame = loader:AddBoardFrame()

    self.m_modalFrame = content:GetChild("frame") or false
    self.m_content = loader.component
    self:OnOffClickClose(self.m_closeWhenClickFrame)

    local frame = self.m_content:GetChild("frame")
    if frame then
        self.closeButton = frame:GetChild("closeButton")
        self.dragArea = frame:GetChild("dragArea")
        self.contentArea = frame:GetChild("contentArea")
    end

    local root = self.root
    self:SetSize(root.width, root.height)
    
    UIWindow.OnInit(self)
end

---CloseWhenClickFrame
---@param close boolean
function UIModal:CloseWhenClickFrame(close)
    if self.m_closeWhenClickFrame == close then
        return
    end
    self.m_closeWhenClickFrame = close
    self:OnOffClickClose(close)
end

function UIModal:OnOffClickClose(close)
    if self.m_modalFrame then
        if close then
            self:OnClick(self.m_modalFrame, self.OnClickClose, self)
        else
            self:OffClick(self.m_modalFrame, self.OnClickClose, self)
        end
    end

    if self.m_loaderFrame then
        if close then
            self:OnClick(self.m_loaderFrame, self.OnClickClose, self)
        else
            self:OffClick(self.m_loaderFrame, self.OnClickClose, self)
        end
    end
end

function UIModal:OnClickClose()
    self:Hide()
end

function UIModal:OnDispose()
    UIModal.super.OnDispose(self)
    if not self.contentPane then return end
    if not self.m_content then return end
    ---@type FairyGUI.Container
    local container = self.m_loader.displayObject
    container:RemoveChild(self.m_content.displayObject)
    self.m_content = false
    self.m_loader.url = nil
end

return UIModal
